summary: TerraScope is a data analytics project under the challenge "Be An Earth Space Detective" where we had analyzed province wise precipitation data from NASA Power portal, analyzed it using Pandas and built a tool that would assist people across three domains(farmers, planners, researchers) for their tasks that would require precipitation data across 7 provinces of Nepal with additional features including them being able to compare two provinces and predict the pattern.
details:
TerraScope is a province wise precipitation analysis tool designed to make NASA Power public data more accessible and impactful to people across various sectors in Nepal.

The project has multidimensional application as it is built for farmers, planners and researchers such that each can use it for various purposes.

The core idea of TerraScope lies in utilizing the past 10 years precipitation data on monthly basis for better decision making and impact in Nepal.

For this project, 10 years precipitation data from NASA power was collected and saved in CSV format for 7 different provinces and analyzed using PANDAS to get insights and "trends" as per requirements of our targeted audience.

A web application was built with minimal and straightforward user interface and the insights received. The web application consists of features such as prediction of future precipitation, comparision tools and rainfall maps of all 7 provinces which would make it more impactful.

Lastly, it also consists of chatbot and AI overview for further assistance of users with graphs and dashboards.
